existingRepairContract: tests/v2130/independent_v213_cases.cjs and tests/v2130/reference_safe_repairs.cjs independently declare two through four repeated identical http:// or https:// schemes, an absolute literal final URL without credentials, and no mixed schemes, inner-path substitution or fivefold prefix.
composition: Only a verified local native redirect or an exact native citation can establish the native family. Its existing bounded argument adaptation must preserve the selected source field value and part index. A fresh v213ReferenceFieldPlan and proof must authorize exactly the protocol-chain URL-value edit, without quote, equals, identifier, duplicate or other compound corrections. The field must be the only field for its native URL role, counting blank aliases.
preserved: All original argument keys, accepted native aliases, other values, whitespace and source context remain unchanged by this transaction. The ordinary pipeline may separately compose an independently proved header or invalid-key repair.
refusals: Protected code examples and unknown owners
Malformed source or unproved template identity
Non-URL fields and unsupported native families
Credentials, control characters, dynamic syntax and inner URL text
Disabled syntax, structural, citation, reference or compatibility options
